item.title: B.C. teen who died in Australia eulogized as 'curious, bold and alive to world'
item.description: VICTORIA — The family and friends of Canadian teenager Piper James who died in Australia last month remembered her as "curious, bold and alive to the world" during a celebration of life held Saturday in Campbell River, B.C. on Vancouver Island.

item.description: 'Sometimes we need to be clever and innovative': As the Ford government works to connect every Ontarian to primary care by 2029, new technology is giving doctors more time to focus on patients

item.title: Canada's pro-U.S. stance in Iran attack carries security risks — and political bets
item.description: Canada's support for U.S. strikes against Iran could come with security risks as the regime looks to retaliate against perceived enemies abroad, say experts, who also note the political gamble of betting on an attack with uncertain aims and outcomes.

item.title: 'D-Day for Iranians': Some Iranian Canadians welcome U.S. attack of Iran
item.description: Some Iranian Canadians are expressing their support for foreign intervention in Iran after the U.S. and Israel launched a major attack on the Middle Eastern country, sending missiles into Iran.

item.title: Canada aiming to sign India trade deal this year, Carney says in Mumbai
item.description: MUMBAI — Canada is aiming to sign a comprehensive trade deal with India this year, Prime Minister Mark Carney told a business audience in Mumbai Saturday.

item.title: Carney says Canada supports U.S. action in Iran but won't get involved militarily
item.description: MUMBAI — Prime Minister Mark Carney said he supports the U.S. action in Iran, but Canada will not get directly involved in the conflict after American and Israeli militaries launched an attack on the Middle Eastern country that left its leader dead.

item.title: Anand backs Qatar, United Arab Emirates against Iran attacks
item.description: MUMBAI — Foreign Affairs Minister Anita Anand says attacks by Iran against Canada’s partners in the Middle East must stop.
